Subject: Discovery recap & procurement questions - Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so procurement can move forward: 

Summary of the call:
- Use case: internal-facing embeddings + chat assistant for analytics product (low latency, high throughput).
- Expected prod traffic: ~50k tokens/day initially; spike patterns weekly.
- Success criteria: <=200ms p95 inference on common queries; predictable monthly spend.

Procurement / commercial questions we discussed:
1) Preferred commercial path: PO (net30) vs corporate card for initial pilot?
2) Are you able to approve vendor setup packets (W-9, banking details) through your vendor portal, or do you need us to upload to a specific portal?
3) Would AWS Marketplace or a direct contract be easier for your procurement team? Marketplace can often expedite PO processing.

Attachments / resources I can share: vendor setup packet (W-9, vendor form), sample invoice format, DocuSign link for the MSA + SOW. If you prefer, we can also generate a marketplace quote.

Next steps / proposed actions:
- Samantha: confirm whether Acme requires vendor portal upload or if you can accept emailed vendor documents.
- Tom: confirm payment method preference (PO/net30 vs card) and expected procurement timeline.
- We (Redwood): send vendor setup packet and DocuSign links; loop in Finance if you need a sample invoice.

I'll attach our vendor packet and W-9 in the next email. Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Chu <samantha.chu@acmeanalytics.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & procurement questions - Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from Procurement: 
- We typically purchase with a PO on net30 for enterprise vendors. Corporate card is only used for small pilots (<$2k).
- We use a vendor portal (Coupa) for vendor setup. Procurement requires a completed vendor intake form, a W-9 (for US vendors), and banking/payment details or instructions for vendor portal upload.
- AWS Marketplace would be ideal if Redwood has a listing with a SaaS contract we can purchase directly — does Redwood support marketplace billing for the services you described?

Procurement timeline: once we have a completed intake form and W-9, it's ~2–3 weeks to appear in our vendor portal; PO approval and legal review can add another 1–2 weeks depending on contract redlines.

I'll attach our vendor intake form for you to complete. Can you confirm the email or portal contact to upload to?

Thanks,
Samantha Chu
Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Analytics
samantha.chu@acmeanalytics.com

Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (SaaS contract available). If Acme prefers marketplace procurement, I can provision a marketplace quote and route billing there — that typically shortens procurement timelines, but some customers still need vendor onboarding in their portal for tax/payment setup.

Next suggested items from Redwood:
- We can accept a PO (net30) for the production contract; card is fine for an initial pilot if you'd like faster start.
- If you confirm Coupa contact, we'll upload the documents there. Otherwise, please accept the attached PDF set and the DocuSign link.

Looping in Rishi (SE) and Ben (AM) to help answer any technical/billing questions.

Best,
